title: Red Hat Security Advisory: python-oauthlib security update
description: A security update for python-oauthlib addresses a privilege escalation vulnerability caused by client identity confusion in token grant handlers (CVE-2026-118669). This issue affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. The vulnerability allows an attacker to escalate privileges by exploiting the confusion in client identity during OAuth token grants. Red Hat has released updated packages to fix this issue.
